deadline.value: The Graduate School's application portal lists December 15, 2026 for Physics; the department page still says January 9. Apply by December 15 to be safe.

also.quote: Applications for the Physics and Astrophysics Ph.D. program are open annually from early September to a deadline of January 9th.

gre_subject.value: Required for the Physics track; not considered for the Astrophysics track; waived if you hold a master's in physics or a related field
gre_subject.quote: For the Physics track, GRE subject scores are required. For the Astrophysics track, the GRE subject will not be considered. | The GRE Subject Test score requirement is waived for applicants who have a master's degree in physics or a related field.

supervisor.value: No pre-admission supervisor requirement stated; applicants are encouraged to contact faculty to judge Physics vs Astrophysics track fit
supervisor.quote: Prospective students are also encouraged to contact specific faculty members to determine whether their current research projects align more closely with the Physics or Astrophysics tracks.

funding.value: At least five years of guaranteed funding (stipend, tuition, health fee and insurance) while in good standing
funding.quote: Admission to our Ph.D. program includes at least five years of guaranteed funding – including stipend, tuition, health services fee and health insurance – for students who maintain good standing in the program.

entry_route.value: Holders of a degree equivalent to a US bachelor's may apply; a physics bachelor's is not required if your physics background is strong
entry_route.quote: Graduates of non-U.S. colleges and universities who have completed the equivalent of a U.S. bachelor's degree may apply for admission to the Brown University Graduate School.

also.quote: A bachelor’s degree in physics is not required to apply; however, applicants are expected to have a strong background in physics.

app_fee.quote: A $75 application fee must be paid when an application is submitted.

fee_waiver.value: Not available to international applicants as a rule; in exceptional cases the department may grant one (exceptional circumstances and a very strong record). Email physics-student-affairs@brown.edu before December 1.
fee_waiver.quote: Application fee waivers are not available for international applicants. In exceptional cases, the department may offer a fee waiver to international students, but this is really done for students with exceptional circumstances and a very well-established academic record. If you think this may be applicable to your case, you should contact physics-student-affairs@brown.edu before December 1.

gre_general.quote: The submission of Physics Subject GRE scores is required for applications to the PhD program; the General GRE is optional.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic overall band 7 is the recommended minimum.
ielts_min.quote: For IELTS, the recommended minimum overall band score is 7.

notes: Two PhD tracks (Physics, Astrophysics) are chosen at application and can't be switched. International applicants need verified transcripts (WES/CertiFile course-by-course) before an offer.
